full_judgment: 7. Mr. Md. Nawab Ali, learned Advocate-on-Record for respondent Nos.1-5 could not show that the following comments of the learned Judge of the High Court Division, namely, "the findings on possession and on genuineness of certificate case are findings of fact and as those findings are based upon legal evidence I do not find any infirmity in the judgment of the lower appellate Court." genuinely reflect the lower appellate Court's finding or not.
